test_eval_statements: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate Python statements and capture printed output
test_eval_file: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate Python code from an external file
test_eval_empty_globals: test the pybind11 eval module to verify __builtins__ is present when evaluating with empty globals
test_eval_closure: test the pybind11 eval module to verify closure scope behavior between global and local namespaces
test_eval_failure: test the pybind11 eval module to verify that evaluation failures are handled correctly
